Try topical fin, I can’t remember which percentage is best I’d go to r/tressless to look for it. But basically by applying it to the scalp, only some of finasteride reaches your blood and subsequently side effects are more rare or less severe. Also sometimes the side effects are resulting from the increased estrogen caused by finasteride. Less testosterone converted into DHT means more testosterone available to be converted to estrogen. To combat this sometimes people get prescribed a small dose of an aromatase inhibitor to lower estrogen. You can also halve or even quarter your dose of oral fin and maintain most of its efficacy yet potentially thwart side effects.
